physics-killer-08.title: Nyuton harakat qonunlari va maxsus nisbiylik nazariyasi
physics-killer-08.topic: Nyuton harakat qonunlari va maxsus nisbiylik nazariyasi
physics-killer-08.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-08.material: Yer atmosferasining yuqori qatlamida hosil bo'lgan myuon yer yuzasi tomon vertikal pastga $0.8c$ tezlik bilan uchib keladi. Yer (yer yuzasi) sanoq sistemasida hosil bo'lish nuqtasining balandligi $800\,\mathrm{m}$, myuonning tinch sanoq sistemasida o'lchangan o'rtacha yashash vaqti $2.0\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. $c=3\times10^8\,\mathrm{m/s}$ bo'lganda, myuonning tinch sanoq sistemasida hosil bo'lish nuqtasidan yer yuzasigacha masofa va myuon bu masofani o'tish uchun ketgan vaqt tartib bilan to'g'ri juftlangan javob qaysi?
physics-killer-08.thinking.0: Nyuton harakat qonunlari va maxsus nisbiylik nazariyasi
physics-killer-08.s.s1.prompt: Yer atmosferasining yuqori qatlamida hosil bo'lgan myuon yer yuzasi tomon vertikal pastga $0.8c$ tezlik bilan uchib keladi. Yer (yer yuzasi) sanoq sistemasida hosil bo'lish nuqtasining balandligi $800\,\mathrm{m}$, myuonning tinch sanoq sistemasida o'lchangan o'rtacha yashash vaqti $2.0\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. $c=3\times10^8\,\mathrm{m/s}$ bo'lganda, myuonning tinch sanoq sistemasida hosil bo'lish nuqtasidan yer yuzasigacha masofa va myuon bu masofani o'tish uchun ketgan vaqt tartib bilan to'g'ri juftlangan javob qaysi?
physics-killer-08.s.s1.explain: $\gamma=1/\sqrt{1-0.8^2}=5/3$. Uzunlikning qisqarishi: $L=L_0/\gamma=800\cdot\dfrac35=480\,\mathrm{m}$. Vaqt $t=\dfrac{L}{v}=\dfrac{480}{0.8\cdot3\times10^8}=2.0\times10^{-6}\,\mathrm{s}=2.0\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Bu myuonning xos yashash vaqtiga teng. Yerdagi kuzatuvchi bir xil hodisani vaqtning kengayishi bilan tushuntiradi: $\Delta t=\dfrac{800}{0.8c}=3.3\,\mu\mathrm{s}=\gamma\cdot2.0\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Ko'paytirsa $1333\,\mathrm{m}$ (noto'g'ri javob ①), $\gamma$ o'rniga $v/c$ ko'paytirsa $640\,\mathrm{m}$ (noto'g'ri javob ②), qisqarishni e'tiborga olmasa noto'g'ri javob ④.

physics-killer-08.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
